bootstrap_policy: When a future ChatGPT conversation materially concerns Tristan systems, projects, research, GitHub, or prior work, recover this pointer and the smallest relevant memory capsule/subgraph before relying on recollection alone.
For work referring to dates before the live capture origin, consult the latest historical backfill and its fidelity labels before using generic recollection.
Treat the current conversation actually visible to the assistant as a new authorized live source when durable information should be captured.
Create a new live checkpoint delta rather than rewriting previous live checkpoints.
Link new live checkpoints to the previous live checkpoint using continues/supersedes/touches_system relations as applicable.
Update this global pointer only after a new checkpoint/backfill passes OAK privacy/provenance/structural checks.
Keep raw transcripts, secrets, sensitive personal data and unreviewed IP out of public GitHub.
Do not claim capture of conversations that were never visible or otherwise authorized.
limitations: No background webhook exists here to intercept a conversation that is not actively available to the assistant.
Cross-chat continuity is performed when the future conversation is active and the relevant retrieval/write tools are available.
Historical backfill is reconstructed from accessible summaries/indexes unless exact exported transcript data is available.
The current backfill is partial, not exhaustive account history.
